title: Bond futures: conversion factors, delivery choice, and rate sensitivity
objectives: Build a delivery invoice with consistent face, quote, conversion-factor and accrued-interest units
Explain why conversion factors do not make all eligible bonds economically identical
Derive a bond-forward quotation from dirty cash prices and intervening coupons
Size a first-order Treasury futures hedge using the cheapest-to-deliver sensitivity and state its limits
prerequisites: Bond cash-flow valuation and duration from chapters 08–09; cash-and-carry from chapter 02; clean and dirty prices from chapter 11.
source_scope: Full English captions for positions 29 and 30 read sequentially. Historical delivery/rounding rules are not generalized to all current products. Official CME conversion and delivery descriptions checked; numerical cases and simplified conversion calculations independently constructed.
